note: Mobile home community and RV park (87 spaces) at Lakeport, Moore Haven, on the Lake Okeechobee rim canal, with a boat ramp, clubhouse and fish-cleaning house; the canal reaches the lake through locks. A 55+ park for long-term stays that also welcomes families short-term. --Claude
